description: The extension STORE: every built-in extension the platform offers, the same list for every merchant. Answers 'what can I add', 'do you have a WooCommerce integration', 'can I get X'. For 'what do I already have', use get_installed_extensions instead — this tool only flags each entry with `installed`. `availableOnYourPlan: false` means the subscription plan excludes it: the store hides it in the cabinet and install_extension will refuse — say so instead of trying. LIMITATIONS, do not paper over them: the platform stores only a name, a category, a price and an id per built-in extension — there is NO stored description, so do not invent what an extension does; say what the name and category say and offer to open its page in the cabinet. `price` is a bare stored string with no currency attached — quote it verbatim, never as a formatted amount. Custom extensions built by an organisation are NOT in this list (they need an organisation scope this agent key does not carry); they do show up in get_installed_extensions once installed.
name: hub_get_extension_catalog
title: Browse extension catalog
